# Stingwing locations including map in Burning Springs & Appalachia

![Stingwing locations including map in Burning Springs & Appalachia](/uploads/615_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

For some challenges it is necessary to kill or photograph Stingwings. But the meat of the Stingwings is also interesting for close combat builds. Here you will find a list of spawn locations for Stingwings and a map. The map covers the entire Appalachia area of ​​Fallout 76 including the new map expansion Burning Springs.

## Species of Stingwings

- Stingwing (Variants: Speedster, Sauser, Chaser, Sprinter, Stalker & Shining)
- Burning Stingwing *(Burning Springs only)*
- Corrosive Stingwing *(Burning Springs only)* (Variants: Suicidal, Shining)

## Stingwing spawn locations

- 100% chance
 - South of Whitespring Golf Club (between "83A" and the snake on the map)
 - **Bleeding Kate`s Grindhouse**
 - **Hemlock Springs Dump**
 - Northeast of **Treetops**
 - *Burning Springs:* Northeast of **Abraxodyne Chemical Power Substation**
 - *Burning Springs:* South of **Hocking Hills Train Station** near railroad crossing
- 10-20% chance
 - Beckwith Farm
 - *Skyline Valley:* Between**Tree Ponds** and**Hawksbill Weather Station**
 - *Skyline Valley:* West of**Old Crimora Mine**
 - *Skyline Valley:* Several locations east of the **Trading Post** (see map)
 - *Burning Springs:* Southwest of **Abraxodyne Chemical Power Substation**
 - *Burning Springs:* North, East and South of**Ash Cave**
 - *Burning Springs:* Around**Albany**
 - *Burning Springs:* North and northeast of**Athens**
 - *Burning Springs:* Many more spawn options throughout the area (see map)
